seoTitle: How to Add a Payment Method on Jotform (2026)
metaDescription: Add secure payment gateways like Stripe, PayPal, or Square to your Jotform forms so you can collect donations, sell products, or manage subscriptions.
intro: Whether you're collecting donations, selling products, or setting up recurring billing, Jotform's Form Builder gives you access to dozens of payment gateways without needing a separate checkout system. This guide walks through connecting a payment processor to your form and configuring it for the type of transaction you need.

steps.heading: Open the Form Elements panel
steps.body: From your active form builder canvas, click to add a new form element.

steps.heading: Switch to the Payments tab
steps.body: Browse the available global payment gateways, such as Stripe, PayPal, or Square.

steps.heading: Connect your payment processor
steps.body: Select your preferred gateway and open its properties to start the connection process.

steps.heading: Authenticate your account
steps.body: Log in and authorize your payment provider account to securely link it to your form.

steps.heading: Configure the payment type
steps.body: Decide whether the field should handle product sales, donations, or subscriptions, and set the relevant parameters.

steps.heading: Set up products, pricing, and currency
steps.body: Add your product listings, pricing, and currency filters, then test the setup in sandbox mode before going live.

faq.question: Which payment gateways does Jotform support?
faq.answer: Jotform offers dozens of native payment integrations, including well-known processors like Stripe, PayPal, and Square, accessible from the Payments tab in Form Builder.

faq.question: Can I accept recurring subscription payments?
faq.answer: Yes, the payment field can be configured for subscription-style billing depending on which gateway you connect.

faq.question: Is there a way to test payments before going live?
faq.answer: Yes, most gateways support a sandbox or test mode so you can verify the checkout flow before accepting real transactions.

faq.question: Does adding a payment gateway cost extra?
faq.answer: Payment processors typically charge their own transaction fees separately from your Jotform subscription, so check your provider's pricing before connecting.
